roleContext.roleTitle: Senior Technical Program Manager, Platform Reliability
roleContext.jobDescription: Our company provides a cloud data-warehouse service to about 2,000 business customers. The Senior Technical Program Manager runs cross-team programs on platform reliability, such as region expansion and disaster-recovery testing, keeps the integrated plan and dependency map, chairs the weekly program review with engineering managers and reports status to the VP of Engineering. The role requires at least two years at senior technical program manager level, or an equivalent level documented by a previous employer, and experience running programs that span at least five engineering teams.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Senior Technical Program Manager, Platform Reliability

## Experience

- Senior Technical Program Manager, Vantor Data Cloud (March 2023 to August 2026): ran the second-region expansion program across nine engineering teams, keeping the integrated plan and the cross-team dependency map in the planning tool.
- Chaired the Tuesday program review with the engineering managers, tracking each risk with an owner and a closure date in the program's RAID register.
- Sent a fortnightly status report to the VP of Engineering with milestone status, top risks and the decisions needed from leadership.
- Technical Program Manager, Vantor Data Cloud (January 2020 to February 2023): coordinated the move of the build system to a new CI service across four teams.
- Took part in planning the annual failover exercise, collecting runbooks from the service teams and booking the test windows.

## Work samples

- Work sample: an anonymised dependency map and milestone plan from the second-region expansion program, showing the nine teams, their critical-path dependencies, slipped milestones and the decisions recorded at the program review.
